chunks: My father and the group of my scholars, may Allah have mercy on them, narrated from Sa'd ibn Abdillah from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn Ubaydillah from Abdillah ibn Maymun al-Qaddah from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

The Commander of the Believers (peace be upon him) passed by Karbala with some of his companions. When he passed by it, his eyes flowed with tears, then he said: 'This is where their mounts will rest, and this is where their tents will be cast down, and here their blood will be shed. Good fortune to you, O land upon which the blood of the beloveds is shed.'

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤِمِنِينَ: Commander of the Believers (Title of Imam Ali)
key_terms.مُلْقَى رِحَالِهِمْ: Place where tents are cast down

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali say when he visited Karbala?
ai.summary: In this foundational narration from *Kamil al-Ziyarah*, Imam Ali (a.s.) identifies Karbala as the prophesied site of the Ahl al-Bayt's martyrdom, establishing its spiritual geography for future pilgrims. The phrase 'Tuba laka' (Blessed is you) elevates the land's sanctity, linking the physical soil to the metaphysical status of the Imams, a concept central to Shia devotional practice and the theology of Ziyarah.
